sources.snippet: Left: original bf16 · Right: this INT4 model (same prompt and seed). This is a dynamic 4-bit quantized version of PrunaAI/P-H3-Image using SDNQ. Both the transformer and the Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder are quantized; the VAE and the text connector stay in bf16. The prompt upsampler is not included in ...
